# Family recipes

## Sourdough bread

Mix 500 g bread flour, 350 g water, 100 g active starter and 10 g salt. Fold the dough four times during the first two hours, then proof overnight in the fridge. Bake in a covered pot at 240 degrees for 20 minutes, then uncovered at 220 degrees for 20 more.

## Tomato soup

Roast 1 kg tomatoes with garlic and onion at 200 degrees for 35 minutes. Blend with 500 ml vegetable stock and a spoon of honey. Finish with basil and a swirl of cream.

## Chickpea curry

Fry a chopped onion with 2 teaspoons of garam masala, add two tins of chickpeas, a tin of coconut milk and a handful of spinach. Simmer for 15 minutes and serve with rice.

## Lemon cake

Cream 200 g butter with 200 g sugar, beat in 4 eggs, then fold in 200 g flour and the zest of two lemons. Bake at 170 degrees for 45 minutes and brush with lemon syrup while warm.
